fact: In June 2024 the Eswatini Data Protection Authority issued a warning (enforcement notice under section 41 of the Data Protection Act 2022) to MTN Eswatini after a customer complained to its call centre on 5 February 2024 that her Mobile Money statement was shared with a third party without consent.
title: EDPA Notice No. 3/2024: Enforcement Notice in Terms of Section 41 of the Eswatini Data Protection Act 2022 - MTN Eswatini
